title: local-server policy rule, format version 1
description: One policy rule document (D-15, D-25). Stored in grt_policy_rule.body with format_version 1. The decoder in internal/policy/rule.go is the reference: it also refuses duplicate keys, null values, invalid UTF-8 and trailing data, and requires at least one effect (deny, windows, priority or caps), deny on its own, and windows together with time_zone.

format_version.description: The rule format version this document is written in.

when.description: Which requests the rule applies to. Every condition given must hold. Leave it out to apply to every request the rule's scope covers.

properties.description: Request properties (LS-Request-Properties) the request must carry with exactly these values. A bare header key is true. A string matches a token or a string of the same text.

models.description: Engine model names; the request's model must be one of them.

deny.description: true refuses every matching request (policy_denied). Cannot be combined with windows, priority or caps.

time_zone.description: The zone the windows are read in: an IANA name (Europe/Berlin), UTC, or Local for the host machine's zone. Required with windows, refused without.

windows.description: Daily time windows, for example background-work hours. A matching request outside every window is refused (outside_time_window).

start.description: Start of the window, HH:MM in 24 hours, inclusive.

end.description: End of the window, HH:MM in 24 hours, exclusive. An end before the start means the window crosses midnight. Must differ from start.

priority.description: The priority class of matching requests. The first matching rule by position that sets one decides; with none a request is interactive.

caps.description: Limits for matching requests. Each takes the smallest of the grant's value and every matching rule's, so a rule can only narrow.
